label: BlobStore.getStream — resource leak fix (abandoned-stream FD guard + file handle)
summary: Fixed resource leak in BlobStore.getStream where abandoned ReadableStream (never read, never cancelled) leaked FD guard entries and file handles indefinitely

changes.kind: refactored getStream() — unified cleanup function, abandon timeout, verified cleanup on all paths

handoff_notes: getStream() now uses a single `cleanup()` function that both releases the FD guard slot and closes the file handle
A 60-second unreferenced abandon timeout fires cleanup if the stream is never read and never cancelled
The `cleanedUp` boolean guard prevents double-cleanup across all paths (pull end, pull error, cancel, timeout)
Outer catch block also calls `release()` directly on construction failures (unchanged behavior)
The `isNotFound` check was added to the outer catch so that a race condition (file deleted between access check and open) returns null instead of throwing
